flags.title: The IRN window is closing
flags.detail: 31 invoice(s) are within a week of the 30-day registration deadline. After it the portal refuses them outright, and an invoice without an IRN is not legally valid.
flags.ask: Which invoices are close to the 30-day e-invoice deadline, and what happens if we miss it?

flags.title: MSME bills near the 45-day limit
flags.detail: 2 bill(s) worth ₹87,000 are close to or past 45 days. Under section 43B(h) the expense stops being deductible in this year if they are not paid.
flags.ask: Which MSME supplier bills must we pay this week to stay within 45 days, and how much in total?

flags.title: Invoices still in draft
flags.detail: 1 invoice(s) have never been issued, so nothing has been posted for them and no customer has been asked to pay.
flags.ask: Which invoices are still in draft, and how much would they add to our sales?
